objective: If and only if a v3 freeze or selected profile requires heterogeneous reusable authority, define a standing_envelope whose clause-local associations and explicit disjunction-of-conjunction composition cannot imply a Cartesian product.
falsifiable_claim: A v3 standing envelope can admit an effect assembled from sibling clauses or undeclared composition, or delegation can merge, split, reassociate, or add a required clause.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

in_scope: Canonically sorted clause IDs; clause-local action/effect, scope, primitive, resource/destination, budget, call, time, risk, and caveat bindings; normalized disjunction-of-conjunction branches; exact one-branch admission; signed attenuation; chain-wide meter identity shared by every delegated descendant; disjoint mutable meters; complete admission evidence.
out_of_scope: Changing or reinterpreting v1/v2 fields, bytes, semantics, exact_effect, or batch_manifest.
implementation_actions: On activation only: source-neutral ADR, authority object, wallet doctrine/API, receipts, v3 schemas and projections, security/conformance, runtime evaluator, attenuation verifier, usage ledger, PEP evidence, and offline verifier—in that order.
consequential_effects_and_final_invokers: No present effect; this record is dormant until its explicit activation condition is selected.
ordered_product_operator_journey: Select v3 condition; freeze semantics; implement owner state and evidence; prove exact-one-branch admission and attenuation; enable only the selected profile.
metrics_and_frozen_thresholds: No match, multiple matches, missing context, unknown implication, undeclared composition, sibling union, and Cartesian product all fail closed.
compatibility_and_migration: Retained v2 fields are signed global ceilings only and never tuples; v1/v2 historical evidence is untouched. A delegated child retains the parent's signed meter-family identity and consumes against the same clause-local and envelope-global owner heads; delegation never creates a fresh budget or call pool.
positive_proof: One effect matches exactly one complete named branch and every clause-local and envelope-global constraint and meter head.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Permutation, duplicate branch, ambiguous branch, clause smuggling, sibling union, reassociation, meter overlap, stale head, delegation widening, descendant meter substitution, and parent/child concurrent budget multiplication refuse.
remaining_nonclaims: This record does not activate v3 and is not selected by current exact-effect work.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Do not begin or select this record unless an owner-approved v3 freeze or selected profile explicitly requires heterogeneous standing authority.

standing_envelope_semantics.subject: sole reusable-authority commitment
standing_envelope_semantics.composition: canonically normalized disjunction of nonempty conjunction branches over sorted clause IDs
standing_envelope_semantics.delegation: signed attenuation may drop alternatives and narrow retained clauses/ceilings only
standing_envelope_semantics.meters: each root envelope defines a signed meter-family identity; every delegated descendant retains it and atomically consumes the same applicable clause-local and envelope-global exact-head owner state, so delegation cannot multiply calls or budgets
